mode: Read-only inspection of existing result.json, trial.log, verifier logs and saved agent trajectories. No model/API request, test execution, scoring rerun or production mutation.
source_path_rule: Each trial row names a directory under source_base/trials; evidence line numbers refer to that directory's trial.log. Original exception fields are read from its result.json. For tests-directory cases the trial name is <task>__seed0__first for manual0, otherwise <task>__seed0__manual<N>.

latest_observed_summary.interpretation: The field infrastructure_unscored is the residual count of terminal task/seed entries without an accepted native score. It is not a claim that every entry failed because of network or infrastructure, and it is not a reduced scoring denominator.

tmux_last_command_audit.source_rule: Original trials/<trial>/agent/trajectory.json steps and observation, plus original result exception.

cases.last_command_summary: Three C-c keystrokes followed by newline; earlier step21 targeted job%1 and vim with kill commands.
cases.conclusion: session disappeared; cause unconfirmed. Agent interrupts/job-control actions are recorded, but do not prove which process ended the tmux server.

cases.observation_summary: The same final observation prints exit, asciinema recording finished/saved, and an Apptainer> prompt. A later tmux send-keys reports no server running.
cases.earlier_actions: Step15 targeted the QEMU process/job and /app/vm-serial plus /app/vm-monitor, not the Harbor tmux socket.
cases.conclusion: An agent-issued EOF and shell/recording exit are direct evidence of agent participation in the terminal failure. Full tmux disappearance causality remains unconfirmed; it must not be labelled a proven network/infrastructure outage.
